create_ActivationSparsifier: create an ActivationSparsifier to sparsify neural network activations using configurable aggregate, reduce, and mask functions
register_layer_ActivationSparsifier: register a model layer with the ActivationSparsifier to collect and aggregate its input activations
step_ActivationSparsifier: run the ActivationSparsifier step to compute sparsification masks from accumulated activations
squash_mask_ActivationSparsifier: squash the ActivationSparsifier masks and attach sparsify hooks to apply pruning during forward passes
state_dict_ActivationSparsifier: get the ActivationSparsifier state dict containing masks, data groups, and defaults for serialization
